previousRule: WELCOME5 derived the mixed-cart persistence key from the review and sample-credit reservation only. A fresh guest attempt with the same cart produced the same globally unique group key under a different owner, causing a 409 database conflict.
newRule: WELCOME5 mixed-cart persistence keys include the browser's random order attempt as well as the reviewed price and credit. Repeating one attempt remains idempotent; a new guest attempt with the same configuration gets a distinct group.
reason: After the first checkout-key fix went live, a fresh-browser WELCOME5 checkout still failed. Production Supabase logged a duplicate cushion_checkout_groups primary key on commit_cushion_checkout. This follow-up prevents cross-attempt key collisions without changing the welcome discount or stock checks.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested complete checkout reliability and posted the exact-head approval for the preceding hotfix. This new protected change requires a new Nylon1 exact-current-head comment before merge or production deployment.
